units.source_text: 不知道是不是突然袭击奏了效，反正他成功地把女人拖了出来。

en.t: Whether the sudden attack had worked or not, in any case he succeeded in dragging the woman out.

units.source_text: 女人精疲力尽，被男人拽着衣襟，像只口袋似的被拖了出来。

en.t: The woman was utterly exhausted, and with the man gripping her collar, she was dragged out like a sack.

units.source_text: 手电光把洞穴三面包围得水泄不通，宛如夜间祭典中燃起的篝火。

en.t: The flashlight beams hemmed in three sides of the pit so tightly that nothing could get through, like bonfires blazing at a night festival.

units.source_text: 尽管没那么热，晃晃悠悠，薄膜似的汗水顺着腋下流了下来，连头发也像被水浇过了似的湿漉漉的。

en.t: Although it was not that hot, a wavering, thin film of sweat ran down from his armpits, and even his hair was wet as if water had been poured over it.

units.source_text: 被压缩成一块木板的震耳喊声，像黑色的巨大翅膀，布满了整个天空。

en.t: The deafening shouts, compressed as if into a single wooden board, spread across the whole sky like enormous black wings.

units.source_text: 男人形成一种错觉，仿佛那翅膀就是自己的翅膀。

en.t: The man fell under the illusion that those wings were his own.

units.source_text: 他分明感到，崖上屏息注视自己的家伙们就是自己。

en.t: He felt distinctly that the people on the cliff, holding their breath and staring at him, were himself.

units.source_text: 他们是他的一部分，他们滴下的染上颜色的唾液，完完全全地，就是他的情欲。

en.t: They were a part of him, and the colored saliva dripping from them was, completely and entirely, his own lust.

units.source_text: 他打算，与其做活供品，不如做代理执行人。

en.t: He intended to become the proxy executioner rather than serve as a living offering.
